slides.title: POV: the venue texts you 2 days before the wedding
slides.body: "We need your certificate of insurance listing us as additional insured."

slides.title: "Sending it now."
slides.body: ...wait. The one on file expired in September.

slides.title: "We can't let vendors load in without a current one."
slides.body: Cue the call to your insurance agent.

slides.title: Know your renewal dates before the venue asks.
slides.body: Save this for the next big event.
